patterns.what_worked: classic_anniversary checked first, then prove-by-diff that classic_era and classic_titan are byte-identical (ignore-cr-at-eol) across the whole tooltip machinery set — one verified body covers three branches with exact file:line quotes. TOC dependency-chain walk settled which of the two GameTooltip_SetDefaultAnchor definitions wins on the classic family.
patterns.what_was_hard: SetOwner is a native method on all five branches — its point-clearing semantics cannot be quoted from the UI mirror; documented as observable contract and explicitly flagged unprovable instead of guessed. Raw anniversary-vs-era diffs were pure CRLF noise requiring ignore-cr comparison.
patterns.skill_gap: None blocking; native-client behavior (SetOwner anchor reset, SetPoint replace-on-same-triple engine semantics) is inherently outside the mirror and must stay labeled as such.

escalation.recommendation: Addon-side desk should treat the 0.2s owner:UpdateTooltip() re-stamp of SetDefaultAnchor as the load-bearing client fact: a restore must run after every SetDefaultAnchor (e.g. OnTooltipSetUnit) or remove its own differently-named anchor point, or the multi-anchor/stale-anchor state explains the stuck-mid-screen symptom. Operator in-game observation on classic_anniversary outranks this file if they conflict.
